configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: Phase B/0: light deps only (ImGui/ImPlot/SQLite/json/yaml/Catch2). No RDKit yet.

configurePresets.name: windows-science
configurePresets.description: Enables the heavy science vcpkg feature (RDKit, libcurl). Long first build.

configurePresets.name: windows-cuda
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 + CUDA - first-party GPU docking engine
configurePresets.description: Adds the first-party CUDA GPU docking backend (nvcc-compiled kernel). Lean base (no science/curl/webview2 - GPU docking needs none of them). Requires the full CUDA Toolkit with nvcc; CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER points at v13.3 and the arch defaults to sm_86 (RTX 3080 Ti). Override CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER/ARCHITECTURES for a different toolkit/GPU.

configurePresets.name: windows-static
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 RELEASE - fully static (single self-contained exe)
configurePresets.description: Phase E release build: x64-windows-static triplet + static CRT (/MT) so StimLab.exe needs no DLLs or VC++ redist. Heavier first build (all deps rebuilt static).

configurePresets.name: windows-science-static
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x64 RELEASE - fully static + science (single exe w/ live agent + web tools)
configurePresets.description: Phase E science release: everything in windows-static (x64-windows-static + static CRT /MT) PLUS the science feature, so ONE self-contained StimLab.exe also carries the live Anthropic provider + web_search/web_fetch. curl[ssl] resolves to Windows-native Schannel and is linked statically (no OpenSSL, no DLLs). Heavier first build (static libcurl).
